site_brief: NRCS AWDB site metadata and element periods of record; coverage counts recomputed at fetch time

provenance.awdb: NRCS NWCC AWDB REST, provisional and subject to revision; values stored raw in reported units, see per-site units table
provenance.prcp: PRCP is a daily accumulation increment; consuming code must confirm accumulation-vs-increment semantics before water-balance use
provenance.units: WTEQ/PRCP/SNWD in inches (x25.4 -> mm); TAVG/TMAX/TMIN in degF ((F-32)x5/9 -> degC)
